title: 第33章 绞肉机已就位
content_zh:
第33章 绞肉机已就位-《全民饥荒：SSS级天赋酿酒师》

上一章

存书签

下一章

届时，便会形成垄断。

挡人财路，如杀人父母。

这群人怕的不是怪物，而是大权旁落。

果然，有人带头，牛鬼蛇神纷纷下场。

赵坤不甘示弱，紧跟着拉起大旗。

“战盟收人！只要有武器的兄弟，进组互保！”

孙倩的头像换成了一朵带刺的红花。

“蔷薇卫队只招女玩家，男的滚粗，姐妹们抱团取暖。”

群魔乱舞，整个频道彻底沦为势力瓜分的修罗场。

冷不丁地，一些熟悉的ID杀入战场。

“信方芸，比信某些吃成球的所谓高手靠谱一百倍！”

先前受过方芸恩惠的求生者们如梦初醒，附议声接连响起。

“就是！方芸大佬教我们种田的时候，你们这帮人还在吃土呢！”

“方芸妹子，你拉个群吧，我们跟你混！”

巨大的声望夹杂着压力压向方芸。

方芸呼吸一滞，求助般看向壁炉边的男人。

许默面沉如水，毫不犹豫地摇头。

“不是时候。”

枪打出头鸟，明晚的灰雾才是真正的要命，现在拉帮结派纯粹是嫌命长。

他切出私聊界面，给叫王星的追随者甩过去一行字。

“最重要的目标是度过明晚，活下来才有资格谈以后。有什么事，明晚过后再说。”

几秒钟后。

王星将许默的原话，略加修饰后重重砸在区域大群的正中央。

原本沸腾的频道凉了下来。

冷酷，决绝，带着浓郁的血腥味。

拉帮结派的狂热退潮般消散。

次日清晨，大雾弥漫。

倒计时宛如催命符。

【入夜倒计时：11小时59分】

许默果断划掉虚拟面板上的伐木计划。

都什么时候了，还管那几块烂木头？

活不过今晚，全都是别人的遗产。

粗糙的圆木在庇护所前堆积如山。

五米高的简易瞭望台拔地而起，系统开始建造。

木楔子被石斧狠狠砸进卯榫，发出令人牙酸的闷响。

By then, a monopoly will be formed.

Blocking people's way of making money is like killing your parents.

What these people fear is not monsters, but the loss of power.

Sure enough, someone took the lead, and all the demons and monsters came to an end.

Not to be outdone, Zhao Kun immediately raised the banner.

"The war alliance accepts people! As long as brothers have weapons, join the group to protect each other!"

Sun Qian's avatar was changed to a red flower with thorns.

"The Rose Guard only recruits female players. The men will get out of here, and the sisters will hug each other for warmth."

The demons were dancing wildly, and the entire channel was completely reduced to a Shura field divided by forces.

Suddenly, some familiar IDs entered the battlefield.

"Believing Fang Yun is a hundred times more reliable than trusting some so-called masters who eat into balls!"

The survivors who had received Fang Yun's favor before woke up from a dream, and voices of agreement sounded one after another.

"That's right! When Boss Fang Yun taught us how to farm, you guys were still eating dirt!"

"Sister Fang Yun, form a group and we'll hang out with you!"

The huge reputation mixed with pressure pressed on Fang Yun.

Fang Yun's breath froze and she looked at the man by the fireplace for help.

Xu Mo's face was as dark as water and he shook his head without hesitation.

"Not the time."

The first thing to do is to shoot the first bird, the gray fog tomorrow night will be the real killer, and forming gangs now is purely because of longevity.

He cut out the private chat interface and sent a line of text to his follower named Wang Xing.

"The most important goal is to survive tomorrow night. Only if you survive can you be qualified to talk about it later. If you have any questions, let's talk about it after tomorrow night."

After a few seconds.

Wang Xing slightly modified Xu Mo's original words and then slammed them into the center of the regional group.

The originally buzzing channel cooled down.

Cold, decisive, with a strong smell of blood.

The frenzy of cliques dissipated like an ebb.

The next morning, heavy fog filled the air.

The countdown is like a reminder.

[Countdown to nightfall: 11 hours and 59 minutes]

Xu Mo decisively crossed out the logging plan on the virtual panel.

How long has it been since you still care about those pieces of rotten wood?

If you don't survive tonight, it's all someone else's legacy.

Rough logs piled up in front of the shelter.

A five-meter-high simple observation tower was erected and the system began to be constructed.

The wooden wedge was smashed into the tenon by the stone axe, making a teeth-searing muffled sound.
